title: Eric Ries on TikTok: 'I accidentally created a dangerous generation of founders'
summary: 55-second clip from Eric's BookThinkers collab — Eric reckoning with the Lean Startup's downstream effects on a generation that learned to ship fast without learning how to protect what they built. Best-performing Eric TikTok of the past month (558 plays, 10 likes in 24h).
blockquote: *I accidentally created a dangerous generation of founders*
